Documentation › Apps

Dev Hub

One-click installers for editors, languages, cloud tools, databases, containers and more, and project workspaces

Dev Hub installs developer tools from their official sources, so they are always current. Each install runs in a progress window with an embedded terminal: it shows every command, keeps the log visible if something fails, and asks for the administrator password there when needed. Installed tools show a check mark.

#Project Workspaces

For each repository or folder, a workspace opens your editor, a terminal and Files together; in the Aurora session it can also remember where those windows were and put them back. Spotlight finds projects by name and opens their workspace from the right-click menu.
